description: This file defines the MatchRepository class which acts as a facade to interact with the MatchService for fetching match data based on filter preferences in a dating app frontend.

classes.name: MatchRepository
classes.description: Repository class that provides an interface to fetch match data from the MatchService, translating filter preferences into service query parameters.

methods.name: fetchMatches
methods.description: Fetches a list of matches based on the provided filter preferences by calling the associated MatchService.
